tools.name: tc_status
tools.description: Freshness, size and source-agreement stats of the token universe. Call first; quote generated_at.

tools.name: tc_list_tokens
tools.description: Page through scored tokens with optional filters. Sorts: health, mcap, revenue, net_flow, ps, unlock_30d, alerts, name.

tools.name: tc_get_token
tools.description: One token's full scorecard (about 8 KB): six pillar scores, the stat grid with a provenance tag per figure, ARR change over 1D/7D/30D/1Y, 30-point history, revenue basis, analyst facts, lens, links, gaps, and this token's alerts and source conflicts. Use only when tc_get_token_digest lacks what the

tools.name: tc_get_token_digest
tools.description: One token in about 1 KB: latest price, valuation, revenue and flows, 7- and 30-day changes, health score with its six pillar scores and verdict, supply unlocks, lens, and data-quality counts. Prefer this over tc_get_token.

tools.name: tc_search_tokens
tools.description: Find slugs by symbol or name before calling tc_get_token_digest.

tools.name: tc_alerts
tools.description: Recent threshold alerts (revenue deterioration, emission acceleration, unlock cliffs, flow flips).

tools.name: tc_resolve
tools.description: Turn a symbol, $cashtag, name or slug into Token Command Center slugs. Returns exact (one slug) or ambiguous=true with every candidate when tokens share a symbol (e.g. POL); never guess between them. Call before a digest when the user names a token.

tools.name: tc_screen
tools.description: Screen the whole Book (all scored tokens) and get compact ranked rows. Filters: lens (long, short, no-edge), verdict (Real, Mid, Theater), tier, category, flow_model (comma-separated for several), stale, query; numeric ranges via min/max objects, e.g. {"min": {"health": 60, "arr": 1000000}, "max": {

tools.name: tc_compare
tools.description: Two to six tokens side by side: price, valuation, revenue and its 7/30-day change, holders revenue, net-flow yield, P/S, unlocks, health with six pillar scores, verdict, lens, and any frozen-price or old-scorecard flags. Accepts slugs or unambiguous symbols.

tools.name: tc_brief
tools.description: The whole Book in about 1.5 KB: freshness and caveats, verdict and lens mix, biggest 30-day revenue movers, highest health, latest high alerts, plus a plain-text version. Use for market-wide questions.

tools.name: tc_get_report
tools.description: Newest markdown scorecard for a slug (clipped). Long; prefer tc_get_token unless the user asks for the write-up.

tools.name: tc_series
tools.description: One token's history as chartable series from TCC's daily snapshots (since 2026-06-09). Each metric returns `summary` {first, last, change_pct, min, max} first — answer trend questions from it — then at most 60 points (weekly by default). Frozen price feeds are null, not flat. Metrics: price, mcap, f

tools.name: tc_calendar
tools.description: Upcoming dated catalysts (unlocks, emission steps, votes, launches) across the Book, soonest first, at most 20. Optional token slug and horizon in days (default 30, max 180). Text is analyst notes.

tools.name: tc_moves
tools.description: Biggest movers: kind=movers ranks 30-day revenue change against price change (divergence); kind=momentum ranks a 14-day composite of revenue, net-flow yield and health changes. Up to 8 up and 8 down. Rows marked base_effect started from almost zero.

tools.name: tc_ledger
tools.description: Prediction ledger tallies: open and graded call counts, next grading date, calls by side. Counts only; individual calls are not published.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "tc_search_tokens" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Find slugs by symbol or name before calling tc_get_token_digest.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "tc_screen" is 1036 chars, far longer than this server's median (199). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
